cohort: 249 women with preeclampsia with severe features treated with magnesium sulfate undergoing cesarean delivery with singleton pregnancies
finding: Interrupted magnesium sulfate infusion was non-inferior to continued magnesium sulfate infusion for rates of postpartum hemorrhage in women with preeclampsia with severe features undergoing cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Interrupted magnesium sulfate infusion was non-inferior to continued infusion for rates of postpartum hemorrhage in women with preeclampsia with severe features undergoing cesarean delivery.
